reason: This package is being built from the creator's approved baseline: storyboard first, copy last. Named lanes were simulated locally to avoid repeating the line-first failure.

lanes.name: Storybook Director
lanes.note: The deck should read as six silent panels: kitchen, thought, softening, doorway drama, shout, freeze.

lanes.name: Human Comedy Guard
lanes.note: The joke is a normal emotional mismatch, not an angry-wife stereotype. Avoid any moral ending.

lanes.name: Visual Continuity Judge
lanes.note: Keep the same kitchen but vary camera language: wide, close hands, close face, doorway depth, wide shout, frozen aftermath.

lanes.name: Copy Restraint Judge
lanes.note: Only the hook, thought bubbles, one shouted line, and brandmark are needed. Delete all thesis copy.
